header: Documents to help you decide on Desiderio

items.title: The pricing one-pager
items.description: All plans on one page for your budget meeting: Community €0, Studio €590, Agency €1,990 and Partner €4,900 a year. It also lists every service.

items.title: The theming guide
items.description: Colour tokens, dark mode and all 15 presets explained. It also shows how to register your own preset and restyle all 244 elements at once.

items.title: The upgrade playbook
items.description: How the seeder works, and a checklist for upgrading Desiderio. For older TYPO3 sites, an upgrade audit costs €690 and ends with a fixed quote.

items.title: Component architecture walkthrough
items.description: 45 minutes on how 17 atoms, 37 molecules, 4 layouts and 4 organisms build 244 consistent content elements.
